title: CBSA letter - direction to report for an interview
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Synthetic; imitates the structure of a CBSA direction for test purposes only.
summary_en: The Canada Border Services Agency directs the person to report to an office on Monday, September 28, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. with their passport for an interview about their removal order.
text:
Canada Border Services Agency
DIRECTION TO REPORT
Client ID: 0000-0000
You are directed to report to the Canada Border Services Agency, Inland Enforcement Office, on Monday, September 28, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Bring your passport and any travel documents.
The purpose of the interview is to discuss the enforcement of the removal order issued against you.
Failure to report as directed may result in a warrant being issued for your arrest.
